title: Experiment: a malformed artifact is dropped from the view while the count still includes it
summary: With the skeleton serving a copy of this project's content, the page reported 178 artifacts and rendered AST-0001. One artifact file was then replaced with invalid JSON. The next request returned HTTP 200 with a normally-formed page, the header still reported 178 artifacts, the number of lint findings shown was unchanged, and AST-0001 was absent from the page. No error, no warning, and no indication that anything had failed to load.

facts.corruption: one assertion file replaced with invalid JSON

omissions.reason: One mode was exercised — syntactically invalid JSON. Schema-valid-but-wrong content, an unreadable file, and a directory in place of a file were not tested and may behave differently.

notes: ⚠️ THE COUNT IS THE PART THAT MAKES THIS BAD. A view that quietly omitted a broken artifact would merely be incomplete. This one omits it AND prints a total that still includes it, so the page actively asserts the artifact is present. An operator has no reason to look for what is missing.
